title: Smiling Young Woman & Toddler in Park, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming black-and-white snapshot from circa 1960 featuring a smiling young woman holding a playful toddler on her lap outdoors. They are seated near a concrete sculpture or fountain ledge, with a curved paved path, manicured lawn, and a small bird in the background. The photo is printed on vintage paper with scalloped deckle edges and bears a blue photo processor code stamp on the back.
